Place the open zip face down on the righ: Sanya fuskar zip ɗin da aka buɗe a gefen dama na yanki na hagu, murɗa daidai akan layin dinki. Yi amfani da ƙafar zip ɗin da ba a iya gani, kuma ɗinka daga sama zuwa ƙasa har sai ƙafar ta taɓa madaidaicin.
Close the zip and chalk the waist seam p: Rufe zip ɗin kuma alli matsayin kubu a kan tef na biyu. Misali, Tolu da ke Ilorin ta yi daidai da ƙugunta a cikin 1 mm ta haka. Dinka gefe na biyu, shima daga sama zuwa kasa.
With a regular zip foot, start the seam: Tare da ƙafar zip na yau da kullun, fara suturar da ke ƙasa kamar 1 cm sama da ƙarshen ɗinkin zip ɗin kuma kusan 2 mm zuwa hagu, don haka layin suna ɗan ɗanɗana ba tare da taɓa nada ba.
Three zip faults and their causes: Laifin zip guda uku da dalilansu
The seam below started too far away from: Dankin da ke ƙasa ya fara nisa da ɗinkin zip ɗin.
The coil was not pressed flat, or the fo: Ba a matse nada lebur ba, ko ƙafar ta yi nisa daga nada.
The seam allowance was not stabilised wi: Ba a daidaita alawus ɗin ɗinki tare da haɗin gwiwa ba.
A bubble at the bottom means the seam be: Kumfa a ƙasa yana nufin ɗinkin da ke ƙasa ya fara nisa da ɗinkin zip ɗin.
Visible zip tape means the coil was not: Tef ɗin zip ɗin da ake gani yana nufin ba'a matse coil ɗin lebur ba, ko ƙafar ta tafi daga gare ta.
Waving means the allowance was not stabi: Waving yana nufin ba a daidaita alawus ɗin ba. Gyara sanadin kafin ku sake sakewa.
Casual and heavier fabrics: Yadudduka na yau da kullun da nauyi

Regular zips, with teeth on the front, a: zips na yau da kullun, tare da hakora a gaba, sun fi ƙarfi da sauƙin gyarawa. A cikin saitin latse, ninka guda ɗaya yana ɓoye haƙora da kuma layi ɗaya na saman.
Invisible zips look like an ordinary sea: Siffofin da ba a ganuwa suna kama da kabu na yau da kullun, mafi kyau don dacewa da lalacewa na lokaci, amma ba su da ƙarfi.
Never sew over metal teeth or the zip st: Kada a taɓa ɗinke haƙoran ƙarfe ko tasha.
Masking tape strip as a guide: Masking tef tsiri a matsayin jagora

For example, Ruth in Kaduna is sewing a: Misali, Ruth a Kaduna tana dinka zip din tsakiya a cikin siket din auduga na ruwa. Ta zaɓi 7 mm a kowane gefen kabu, don haka layuka biyu sun faɗi akan tef ɗin zip, ba tare da haƙora ba. Tafiyar kaset ɗin abin rufe fuska mai tsawon mm 7 yana jagoranta.
At the bottom she stitches across 1 cm b: A kasan ta dinka a fadin santimita 1 kasa da tashar zip, tare da dinkin mm 3.
Never sew over metal teeth or the stoppe: Kada a taɓa yin ɗinki bisa haƙoran ƙarfe ko madaidaicin. Allurar na iya karya kuma ta tashi sama. Yi tafiya da injin da hannu kusa da tasha, sa gilashin idan kana da su, kuma ka mayar da fuskarka baya.
Joy spaces seven blouse buttons: Murna ta sanya maɓallan rigar guda bakwai

For example, Joy in Calabar wants 7 butt: Misali, Joy a Calabar yana son maɓalli 7 akan rigar rigar da aka dace, na ƙarshe yana 42 cm ƙasa da na farko. Maɓallai bakwai suna yin sarari shida, don haka 42 da aka raba ta 6 shine 7 cm baya.
The bust line falls 21 cm down, exactly: Layin bust ɗin ya faɗi ƙasa 21 cm ƙasa, daidai inda maɓallin 4 ya sauka, don haka rigar ba zata gape ba.
Her buttons are 15 mm across and 3 mm th: Maɓallanta sun kai mm 15 a fadin kuma kauri 3 mm, don haka kowane maɓalli yana da mm 18. Ƙarƙashin maɓalli a ƙarƙashin maɓalli kuma gwada ɗaya akan tarkace. Don buɗe shi, sanya fil a kowane ƙarshen, kuma yanke daga tsakiya zuwa waje.
Sew every button with a shank: Dinka kowane maɓalli tare da shank
Double thread, small stitch to start: Zare biyu, ƙaramin ɗinki don farawa

A flat button needs a thread shank, a li: Maɓallin lebur yana buƙatar guntun zaren, ɗan sarari don maɓalli na rami. Ba tare da shi ba, ƙullun ƙulli da zaren suna lalacewa. Yi amfani da zaren biyu, kuma sanya sandar ashana a saman maɓallin.
Sew over the stick 5 or 6 times. Remove: Dinka a kan sandar sau 5 ko 6. Cire shi, cire maɓallin sama, kuma kunsa zaren a ƙarƙashinsa sau 4 ko 5. Ƙarshe da ƙananan dinki a baya.
For group orders, wash one sample first,: Don umarnin rukuni, wanke samfurin farko, kuma duba maɓallan har yanzu suna da ƙarfi.
Invisible zip 2 to 3 cm longer: zip mara ganuwa 2 zuwa 3 cm tsayi
Stabilise, press the coil, sew top down: Tsaya, danna coil, dinka saman ƙasa
Never sew over metal teeth or stops: Kada a taɓa ɗinke haƙoran ƙarfe ko tasha
Every sew-through button needs a shank: Kowane maballin ɗinki yana buƙatar shank
To remember. Buy invisible zips 2 to 3 c: Don tunawa. Sayi zips marasa ganuwa 2 zuwa 3 cm tsayi. Tsaya, danna coil, kuma dinka bangarorin biyu sama sama. Kada a taɓa yin ɗinki bisa haƙoran ƙarfe. Girman ramukan maɓalli daga maɓallin. Kuma a ba kowane maɓalli ɗan zaren zare.
Invisible zip sample with a cross line: Samfurin zip marar ganuwa tare da layin giciye

A lining covers the seams, stops scratch: Rufi yana rufe sutura, yana dakatar da yadin da aka saka ko sequins yana taɓa fata, kuma yana taimaka wa suturar ta rataye. Bututun bututu da dauri shaci da gama gefuna.
Beads, lace and appliqué turn a plain ga: Beads, yadin da aka saka da appliqué suna jujjuya tufa guda ɗaya zuwa wani yanki. Amma beads da ke faɗowa a filin rawa suna lalata sunan ku. Bambance-bambancen shine a cikin daidaitawa, tsaro da dubawa.
Polyester: affordable, but can feel hot: Polyester: mai araha, amma yana iya jin zafi
Viscose or cupro: breathable, drapes wel: Viscose ko cupro: numfashi, drapes da kyau
Cotton voile: light and cool for day wea: Cotton voile: haske da sanyi don sawar rana
Satin or taffeta: bridal and evening: Satin ko taffeta: amarya da maraice
Polyester lining is smooth and affordabl: Rufin polyester yana da santsi kuma mai araha, amma yana iya jin zafi da ɗanɗano a cikin zafin Najeriya. Viscose ko cupro yana numfashi kuma yana ɗimuwa kamar siliki, amma yana da tsada kuma yana iya raguwa, don haka kafin a wanke ko tururi.
Cotton voile is cool for children's wear: Cotton voile yana da kyau ga suturar yara da riguna na rana. Satin ya dace da kayan amarya da kayan yamma. Kuma rigar da aka shimfiɗa tana buƙatar lilin da ke shimfiɗawa kamar masana'anta na waje.
A lining must never pull: Dole ne rufin ya taɓa ja
Sew lining side seams 3 to 5 mm smaller,: Dinka gefen sutura mai ƙarami 3 zuwa 5 mm, don ƙarin sauƙi.

French tacks 2 to 3 cm long at the hem: Faransanci yana da tsayin 2 zuwa 3 cm a gindi
Linings stretch less and sit inside, so: Lining ya ɗan miƙe ya zauna a ciki, don haka suna buƙatar ƙarin ɗaki kaɗan. Yanke daga irin wannan tsari, amma a dinka suturar lilin a tsaye 3 zuwa 5 mm a cikin layin suturar sutura.
Mark the lining hem about 2 to 2.5 cm ab: Yi alama a saman shingen da ke kusa da 2 zuwa 2.5 cm sama da gefen siket, don haka ba zai taɓa fitowa ba. A zip ɗin, ninka labulen 3 zuwa 5 mm nesa da coil ɗin kuma ku zame shi, don haka madaidaicin ba zai taɓa kama shi ba.
Hem both layers separately, and join the: Kashe yadudduka daban-daban, kuma haɗa su a gefen gefe tare da takin Faransanci, sarƙar zaren tsayin 2 zuwa 3 cm wanda zai ba da damar rufin ya motsa.
For example, Patience in Abeokuta saw la: Misali, Patience a Abeokuta ta ga yadin da aka saka yana murzawa a kan cinyar abokin ciniki. Ta sake sake dinke ginshiƙan gefen rufin 4 mm gaba a ciki, ta sami kusan 1.6 cm zagaye kwatangwalo, yadin da aka saka a santsi.
Piping width = cord circumference + two: Faɗin bututu = kewayen igiya + izinin kabu biyu.
Fold the cut edge to the selvedge: true: Ninka gefen yanke zuwa kan kai: son zuciya na gaskiya
Cord 4 mm x 3.14 = about 1.3 cm round: Igiyar 4 mm x 3.14 = kusan 1.3 cm zagaye
Clip on curves; final seam closer to cor: Clip a kan masu lankwasa; kabu na ƙarshe kusa da igiya

For example, Rahila in Abuja uses 4 mm c: Misali, Rahila a Abuja tana amfani da igiyar mm hudu. Dawafinsa yana da kusan 1.3 cm. Ƙara izinin kabu biyu na 1.5 cm: 4.3 cm. Ta yanke 4.5 cm don sauƙi mai sauƙi.
The neckline is 64 cm, plus about 6 cm f: Layin wuyansa shine 64 cm, da kusan 6 cm don haɗawa, don haka tsayin 70 cm. Ta ƙulla bututun a kan masu lankwasa, sannan ta ɗinka ɗinkin ƙarshe kaɗan kusa da igiyar, don haka ɗinkin farko yana ɓoye.
Outline a seam, or finish an edge: Zayyana wani dinki, ko gama da gefe
Use piping to outline a seam. It shows a: Yi amfani da bututu don zayyana wani ɗinki. Yana nunawa azaman layi mai tasowa.
Use binding to finish an edge, such as a: Yi amfani da ɗaure don gama gefe, kamar layin wuya. Daure mai ninki biyu yana buƙatar kusan ninki huɗu da aka gama, don haka kusan 4 cm don ɗaurin 1 cm. Mikewa shi dan kadan a kusa da lanƙwasa na ciki, sa'annan ku haɗa ɗigo tare da digon diagonal don guje wa dunƙulewa.
Press embellished areas only from the ba: Danna wuraren ƙawata kawai daga baya, akan tawul mai kauri.
Satin stitch covers appliqué edges: Satin dinki yana rufe gefuna appliqué
No long thread floats on the back: Babu dogon zaren da ke yawo a baya
Put a stabiliser behind appliqué, beadin: Sanya stabilizer a bayan appliqué, beading da embodier don kada tushen tushe ya yi tsiro. Rufe gefuna appliqué tare da madaidaicin satin kusa, faɗin 2 zuwa 3 mm.
Secure the thread every 3 or 4 beads wit: A kiyaye zaren kowane ƙullun 3 ko 4 tare da ɗan ƙaramin baya, don haka idan zaren ya karye, ƙananan beads kawai sun faɗi. Kada ku ɗauki zaren dogon nisa a baya. Dogayen iyo ya kama kuma ya karye.
Embellish pieces flat, before the seams: Kawata sassa lebur, kafin a dinka rigunan, barin kusan 2 cm a sarari a kowane kabu.
Many beads and sequins cannot take a hot: Yawancin beads da sequins ba za su iya ɗaukar ƙarfe mai zafi ba. Danna su kawai daga baya, a kan tawul mai kauri tare da zanen latsa, kuma gaya wa abokin ciniki yadda ake tsaftace tufafin.
For example, Fatima in Lagos times a 5 c: Misali, Fatima a Legas sau da yawa wani yanki mai tsayi cm 5 a cikin mintuna 20. Tsawon wuyansa shine 60 cm.
Price decorative work from a timed sampl: Farashin kayan ado na kayan aiki daga samfurin lokaci. Wuyan Fatima 60cm yana da sassan 12 na 5 cm. A minti 20 kowanne, wato minti 240, wato awa 4.

Hem linings 2 to 2.5 cm above the hem: Girman shinge na 2 zuwa 2.5 cm sama da ƙafar
Cut bias at 45 degrees for curves: Yanke son zuciya a digiri 45 don masu lankwasa

Lining plan and a French tack: Shirye-shiryen rufi da kuma takin Faransanci

Outside to inside, top to bottom: Waje zuwa ciki, sama zuwa kasa
Hangs straight and symmetrical: Ya rataye madaidaiciya kuma mai daidaitawa

Check pattern matching at the seams, the: Bincika ƙirar da ta yi daidai da rigunan, rigunan da kansu, daɗaɗɗen sama, da ƙafar ƙafa, da kowane ƙwanƙwasa da motif.
Then inside out: finished edges, a free-: Sa'an nan kuma ciki: gama gefuna, rufi mai rataye kyauta, zaren da aka datsa kuma babu alamar alli. A ƙarshe, ma'auni.
Amaka checks a dress against its spec: Amaka yana duban rigar daidai gwargwado

A spec sheet lists the key finished meas: Takaddun takarda ta jera ma'auni na maɓalli da aka gama, kuma haƙuri shine nisan kowane ɗayan zai iya bambanta kuma har yanzu yana wucewa. Misali, Amaka a cikin Enugu's spec ya ce bust 96, kugu 80, hip 104 da tsayi cm 110, kowane kari ko ragi 1 cm.

Unsafe: a broken needle inside, a sharp: Mara lafiya: karyewar allura a ciki, kaifi mai kaifi, ƙaramin maɓalli mara nauyi akan sawar jariri.
The client would be unhappy: a seam open: Abokin ciniki ba zai yi farin ciki ba: buɗaɗɗen kabu, zip ɗin da yake mannewa, mara daidaituwa.
A small flaw that does not affect use, l: Karamin aibi wanda baya shafar amfani, kamar zaren da ba a datse a ciki.
A critical fault makes the garment unsaf: Laifi mai mahimmanci yana sa suturar ba ta da lafiya: karyewar allura da aka bari a ciki, ko ƙaramin maɓalli mara nauyi akan rigar jariri da za a iya haɗiye. Ba a taɓa karɓar manyan laifuffuka.
Count pins and needles before and after: Ƙirƙiri fil da allura kafin da bayan kowane aiki, kuma gudanar da magnet akan tufafin yara kafin mikawa.
A major fault would make the client unha: Babban Laifi zai sa abokin ciniki rashin jin daɗi, kamar buɗaɗɗen kabu ko zip ɗin da ke mannewa. Gyara shi kafin mikawa.

For example, Ijeoma in Asaba's card for: Misali, Ijeoma a cikin katin Asaba na rigar rigar yadin da aka saka, ta ce a wanke hannu da ruwa mai sanyi, kada a yi bleach, a bushe a bushe a cikin inuwa, da kuma baƙin ƙarfe a ƙasa, daga ciki, ba a kan beads.
Tabbatar da biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku na banki. Kar a taba amincewa da hoton allo.
